程序包 org.bukkit.inventory.meta

接口 ItemMeta

所有超级接口:
Cloneable, ConfigurationSerializable
所有已知子接口:
BannerMeta, BlockStateMeta, BookMeta, EnchantmentStorageMeta, FireworkEffectMeta, FireworkMeta, LeatherArmorMeta, MapMeta, PotionMeta, SkullMeta
public interface ItemMeta extends Cloneable, ConfigurationSerializable
This type represents the storage mechanism for auxiliary item data. 此类型表示物品辅助数据的存储机制。

An implementation will handle the creation and application for ItemMeta. This class should not be implemented by a plugin in a live environment. 具体实现将负责 ItemMeta 的创建和应用。插件不应在运行环境中实现此接口。

      Checks for existence of a display name. 检查是否存在显示名称。

    • getDisplayName

      String getDisplayName()
      Gets the display name that is set. 获取已设置的显示名称。

    • addEnchant

      boolean addEnchant(Enchantment ench, int level, boolean ignoreLevelRestriction)
      Adds the specified enchantment to this item meta. 向此物品元数据添加指定的附魔。
      参数:
      ench - Enchantment to add 要添加的附魔
      level - Level for the enchantment 附魔的等级
      ignoreLevelRestriction - this indicates the enchantment should be 表示应忽略等级限制应用该附魔 applied, ignoring the level limit
      返回:
      true if the item meta changed as a result of this call, false 若此调用改变了物品元数据则为 true，否则为 false otherwise

    • addItemFlags

      void addItemFlags(ItemFlag... itemFlags)
      Set itemflags which should be ignored when rendering a ItemStack in the Client. This Method does silently ignore double set itemFlags. 设置在客户端渲染 ItemStack 时应被忽略的物品标志。此方法会静默忽略重复设置的物品标志。
      参数:
      itemFlags - The hideflags which shouldn't be rendered 不应被渲染的隐藏标志

    • removeItemFlags

      void removeItemFlags(ItemFlag... itemFlags)
      Remove specific set of itemFlags. This tells the Client it should render it again. This Method does silently ignore double removed itemFlags. 移除特定的一组物品标志。这会告知客户端重新渲染相应内容。此方法会静默忽略重复移除的物品标志。
      参数:
      itemFlags - Hideflags which should be removed 应被移除的隐藏标志
